ai_summary: ## Executive Summary  Shreyansh Gupta, a member of the Promoter Group of Assam Entrade Limited, has acquired 45,136 equity shares (3.14%) of the company via an off-market gift deed from another member. This internal transfer increases his total holding to 3.47% but does not alter the company's overall share capital or introduce new external ownership. No red flags are apparent, as this is a routine regulatory disclosure for an inter-se promoter group share re-allocation.
